Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If one of my vampires plays burning touch at inferior valeren and my
prey tries to block it with a Nocturn. If the Nocturn burns a blood
to block is the action blocked and unsuccessful even though the
Nocturn moved to the ashheap?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Some ally with 1 life successfully blocks.
Burning Touch causes the ally to lose the life.
So the ally is burned.
But the action was successfully blocked, so it is unsuccessful.
